title: Sunao Katabuchi's 'Fukufuku no Chizu' Anime Short Streams with English Subtitles on YouTube
content: The official YouTube channel for the prefecture of Fukushima began streaming " Fukufuku no Chizu " (Map of Fukufuku), director Sunao Katabuchi 's new anime short , with English subtitles on Monday. The official website for the short posted the animation in Japanese on March 24.
author: ANN

title: Jujutsu Kaisen Studio’s Darkest Series Gets Brand New Look After Netflix Revival
content: MAPPA is one of the biggest animation studios in the industry, and its popularity keeps increasing with several exciting projects. The studio’s most popular anime is Jujutsu Kaisen , which contributed significantly to its groundbreaking success.
author: ComicBook

title: Crunchyroll's Anime Nights Program to Screen Black Clover Season 2, The Vermilion Mask, More on September 21
content: Crunchyroll announced on Tuesday that its " Crunchyroll Anime Nights" program dedicated to screening anime across the U.S. will screen the following anime ahead of their fall releases on September 21.

title: Bleach’s Final Season Confirms Finale Is Coming Soon & Fans Need to Be Ready
content: Bleach: Thousand-Year Blood War has been taking the anime world by storm ever since it made its debut with its final season this Summer , but its grand finale is coming much faster than many fans might be ready for.

title: Major Shonen Jump Revival Confirms Early Release Date With Crunchyroll’s Big Screen Plans
content: A major Shonen Jump series is getting a new anime revival 16 years after it originally came to an end, and Crunchyroll has confirmed an early release date for the new series premiere with plans to bring it to the big screen.
author: ComicBook

title: Pokémon Horizons Anime's Video Previews Pokémon GO Collaboration Episode
content: The staff of the Pokémon: Horizons anime revealed a promotional video on Wednesday previewing the collaboration between the anime and the Pokémon GO app. The Pokémon GO -themed episode, the 150th episode of the overall anime, will air on September 18 and will feature the app's Professor Willow.
author: ANN

title: Aoashi Season 2 Anime's Promo Video Reveals, Previews Theme Songs
content: The staff of the television anime of Yūgo Kobayashi 's Aoashi manga revealed a new promotional video for the second season of the anime on Wednesday. The video previews the anime's theme songs , revealing their titles.
author: ANN

title: Apprentice Nail Artist in a Foreign Land Anime Reveals Main Staff
content: The official X/Twitter account for Shufu to Seikatsu Sha 's Comic PASH! magazine revealed the main staff for the anime adaptation of Marukawa 's Apprentice Nail Artist in a Foreign Land ( Ikyō no Tsumenuri Minarai ) manga on Wednesday.
author: ANN
